correctness.rationale: All nonedges of K3×Kn, n≥3, have distance two and their common neighbours require omitted witnesses. Same-column pairs force each row complement size≥2; same-row pairs force any two row-complement unions size≥3, equivalent to unequal 2-element supports. Binomial counting over support sizes gives the exact four-term T_n(z), all maximal sets have 3 distinct 2-subsets yielding facets size 3n−6. Bin(n,λ/n) per-row omissions converge to Poisson(λ), while duplicate exact two-support probability O(n^-2); hence the stated independent Bernoulli limit. Independent full adjacency-pair enumeration matched all 512,4096,32768 vertex subsets and facets for n=3..5.
residual_risks: No claim about Cartesian product, ordinary visibility, or dependent random selection.
